source_coordinate_method.crs: EPSG:32717 assumed from UTM map grid

scenario.rounding_note: Per-source integer peaks sum to 77309; paper total rounds to 77308. No artificial redistribution.
scenario.time_origin: Simultaneous water release at nine upper-flank sources; not eruption warning time

terrain.conditioning: Priority flood only for depressions requiring at most 2 m. Deeper basins retained. This is an explicit sensitivity assumption, different from the paper.

native_vrt_audit.coverage: Full solver VRT including required border checked before continuing

scenario.compiler_options: O3, native CPU, LTO; no fast-math; independent conservation benchmark passed
limitations: Independent 30m global surface model, not the fine photogrammetric DEM in the study. Vegetation, buildings and narrow canyons are unresolved.
Digitized source coordinates; require original GIS coordinates for exact reproduction.
Buildings and bridges are not hydraulic obstacles.
No tuning to force published city arrivals.
Published RAMMS volumes and arrival times are comparisons, not imposed outputs.

recovery.reason: Process absent after interrupted desktop session; no fatal error in previous log

independent_native_restart_test.scope: Synthetic inclined eroding bed with ongoing source; continuation at5s to10s, same2.5s output spacing

urban_extrema_definition: Maxima among601 native15-second samples, with H>=5cm. Depth is slope-normal; vertical component also provided at the depth maximum. Locations can be inside deep canyons, not streets or uniform city depths.

published_section_context.coordinates_source: Torres y Vásquez2017, tablas3.5 y3.7, páginas impresas88 y92 / PDF113 y117
published_section_context.limitations: The published FLOW-3D section maximum is not necessarily identical to Kestrel's slope-aligned depth-averaged velocity. Different source, terrain and fluid assumptions; comparison is contextual, not calibration.
published_section_context.sampling: Nearest30m cell centers along published cross-section lines sampled every15m; duplicates removed; native outputs every15seconds; H>=5cm threshold. No internal Riemann flux inferred at these lines.

section.description: Comparison section south of Sangolqui-San Rafael rectangle, spanning both Pita and Santa Clara corridors; not an administrative boundary
section.method: Cell-center H * gamma * north velocity * dx, interpolated between adjacent rows; trapezoid integration every 15 s. Not internal numerical face flux.
limitations: Positive transport can count recrossing material more than once; net transport is also reported.
Subsampling difference tests time sampling only; it does not bound spatial/model error.
This is not all material that reaches the city or its streets.

comparison_note: Published RAMMS arrival times 52 min Sangolqui and 60/71/84 min San Rafael refer to different scenarios and sources. They are not imposed on this run.
